resources.string: Open a web or radio link

On the next screen, tap ☰ at the top left and choose Drive, then pick your songs or videos (several at once is fine).\n\nIf Drive isn\'t in that list, install the Google Drive app and sign in. Next time the picker opens where you left it.

Suno doesn't let other apps stream its songs, so save them to your phone first:

1. In the Suno app or on suno.com, open your song.
2. Tap ⋯ (More), then Download, then MP3 Audio.
3. Come back here: it's in Music (and in Files, under Downloads).

You can also paste a Suno link; if Suno allows that song to be played elsewhere, it plays here.
